purpose: Replace Neil-rejected stock piano with one freshly generated, original Oceanides STP score. Full score rather than a short repeated stock loop; narration remains the primary explanation.

direction.name: Flow
direction.tonalCentre: D major / suspended and add9 voicings
direction.palette: Glass synth motif, warm bass, airy pads, organic clicks, restrained pulse
direction.voiceSpace: Sparse midrange and steady dynamics; duck against the single personal voice airaandmeagan

input.normalization: Trim final newline only for the provider prompt; normalize CRLF to LF for hashing.

body.prompt:
Compose a fresh original instrumental score called Flow for a premium, minimal, scientifically clear 3D building-wastewater explainer presented to management and procurement. The feeling is calm precision, clean engineering and forward movement. It must have a distinctive small musical identity while remaining subordinate to a Filipino-English spoken narrator.

150 seconds, approximately 86 BPM, 4/4, D-major tonal centre with suspended and add9 voicings. A spare ascending three-note glass-synth motif is the signature; repeat it only at meaningful moments, not continuously. Sound palette: rounded warm bass, airy analog pads, delicate tuned glass plucks, soft organic clicks and a restrained dry electronic pulse. Subtle liquid-like timbres should suggest flow musically, without literal running-water noise.

0-10 seconds: immediate spacious opening with a soft glass motif and warm harmonic bed, no loud logo sting. 10-31: introduce a precise low pulse as the building connects to on-site treatment. 31-65: gentle movement, carefully evolving tiny rhythmic details through screening, settling and biological treatment. 65-96: open the harmony and clear the texture as solids separate and treated water leaves the system. 96-125: grounded, confident and sparse for maintenance and cost discussion. 125-138: return the glass motif, resolve calmly around 134 seconds. 138-150: soft sustained instrumental tail that can be faded to fit the final video.

Produce an intimate, polished stereo mix with a stable centre and soft width. Leave the speech midrange uncluttered: sparse energy around 1-4 kHz, controlled low mids and no piercing high percussion. Maintain consistent restrained dynamics, natural transitions and intentional silence between details. No stock corporate piano, ukulele, motivational jingle, trap hi-hats, trailer drums, EDM drop, dramatic riser or bombastic climax. No vocals, spoken words, choir, humming, vocal pads or vocal samples anywhere. Do not imitate a named artist or reuse any existing recording. Instrumental from the first second to the last.

request.settings: Prompt mode with force_instrumental true. No seed (incompatible with prompt), reference upload, finetune, plan-generation call, inpainting or stems.

limits.remainingQuota: Unavailable to this key. Do not change account permissions, billing settings or subscriptions.
limits.costBasis: Published ElevenAPI music rate $0.15/minute, checked 2026-10-03; 2.5 minutes = $0.375 usage equivalent before tax. This USD approval is separate from the pending narration credit cap. Do not treat a credits figure inferred from a different plan as verified music pricing.

output.provenance: Fresh ElevenLabs Music generation for Oceanides; no saved track or audio reference supplied. Raw score retained; trim/fade/duck locally for the final narration timeline.

pass: Instrumental throughout with no singing, humming, speech or vocal samples.
Distinct restrained glass/pulse identity; coherent opening, treatment progression, clarity lift and calm ending.
Narration remains easy to hear after mixing; no busy lead melody, aggressive drums or loud surprises.
Full audio decode succeeds; approximately 150 seconds with a usable ending and no persistent clipping.
Neil listens and accepts musical fit before client use.
fail: Voice-like sounds, generic corporate piano, abrupt transitions, harsh transients, muddy speech range or unusable ending.
Permission, model, billing or generation error: stop without retry; preserve any received result.
Prompt/model/length/output format or cost above the approved cap changes: fresh approval required.
evidence: Exact prompt/request hashes, one-attempt receipt with whitelisted status/cost headers and song ID.
Raw original score, complete decode/loudness/peak measurements, locally ducked mix and final human listening.
Pending spec guard stops before credentials/network; no stock fallback.
runner: music-original.mjs --dry-run; --generate requires direct human approval of this exact prompt, one-call test and $0.50 usage cap.
delivery: Local review and draft PR only. No public release or streaming distribution.
